responsibility: Implements the core MSP430 backend logic behind target hooks and MD helper routines. It owns target option override and MCU-based validation, machine-function/frame-layout state, prologue/epilogue and return-address handling, calling-convention helpers, include-path registration for MSP430 support headers, operand/address printing, mode and register behavior, helper expansion for shifts and arithmetic, and predicates such as whether high-memory 430X instructions or hardware multiply are required. This is the main C++ source file coordinating MSP430 RTL expansion and assembly emission behavior around the patterns defined in msp430.md.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C++ backend implementation for the MSP430 target hooks, option override behavior, frame/RTL helpers, operand printing, and include-path registration. Unlike msp430.h it provides code rather than target macros/spec wiring, unlike msp430.md it is not the declarative RTL pattern file, and unlike msp430.opt it does not define the option table.
